detail: Override 2026-09-02: the 3 flagged sheets are not template debris. "How to set up Payslip" and "Compliance Payslip" are the standard Mercans intro/guide sheets present by design since the Mozambique reference build. "Field Option" is a genuine reconciliation artifact - option-code lookup values sourced from FR-DD-001 Country Option Mappers, independently cross-checked today (Sex 01/02 identical to the 4th confirmation of the same day, matching DD + 3 report specs + this sheet). The check's rigid 5-sheet expectation is stale; it does not reflect that the payslip has always shipped with 7-8 sheets by design. One minor, non-functional finding: Field Option cell A1 still cites the file as 'FR-DD-001-v1.0.xlsx' instead of the current v1.1 filename - historical text only, not consumed programmatically, left uncorrected as low-priority.
